name: HealthCapsule Doctor Directory

goal.answer: Deliver Module 1 of HealthCapsule Phase 1: a public Doctor Directory with search, verified profile pages, a doctor self-edit portal, and an admin verification/tier-management portal, all inside the existing single Next.js 16 + Prisma codebase.

criteria.answer:
Public doctor search at /doctors supports filtering by specialty, area, and name; only VERIFIED doctors are publicly visible; featured and new-doctor badges render per the tier/registration-year rules.
Doctor profile page at /doctors/[slug] renders BMDC badge, degrees, experience, fee, chambers, and next-available schedule; unknown slugs return a custom 404.
Authenticated DOCTOR portal at /portal/doctor allows editing bio, photo, fee, degrees, languages, and chambers; edits reflect immediately on the public profile.
Authenticated ADMIN portal at /portal/admin shows a doctor verification queue and allows toggling verification status (PENDING/VERIFIED/REJECTED) and listing tier (FREE/VERIFIED/FEATURED/PREMIUM).
Phone + password authentication with NextAuth credentials is wired for DOCTOR and ADMIN roles; middleware blocks unauthenticated access to /portal/* routes.
npx prisma validate, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run build, and npx prisma db seed all succeed without errors.
Seed script loads geography data from /mnt/d/Work/location/*.json and populates specialties plus sample verified/pending doctors with chambers for local development and manual QA.

constraints.answer: Single Next.js 16 codebase with App Router and API routes — no separate NestJS backend., Build on the existing Prisma schema; extend it only where Module 1 requires new data (e.g., chamber schedules)., Use Tailwind CSS v4 and the existing theme/color conventions from the Implementation Plan., Load geography seed data from /mnt/d/Work/location/*.json (divisions, districts, thanas, areas, aliases)., Phone + password credentials auth via NextAuth v4; no SMS/OTP required for Module 1., Preserve existing schema conventions: cuid IDs, soft-delete pattern (deletedAt), indexes, and relation names.

phases.answer: Foundation & Theming, Auth & Roles, Schema Extension & Seed Data, Doctor Directory API & Public Pages, Doctor Portal, Admin Portal

assumptions.answer: Module 1 scope is Doctor Directory only (user confirmed); Hospital/Diagnostic Directory and Appointment Booking are deferred to future Ferments.; Patient users do not need to log in to browse doctors; only DOCTOR and ADMIN roles need authenticated portal access for Module 1.; 'New Doctor' badge is derived from registrationYear within the last 2 calendar years.; Chamber weekly schedules are stored in a new Prisma Schedule model (dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, slotDurationMinutes, maxPatients).; Sample doctor/chamber data for seeding will be synthetic but realistic for Chattogram areas.; No real SMS gateway is integrated in Module 1; admin actions and auth use plain password login.; Existing location JSON files are complete and authoritative for the seed script.

phases.name: Foundation & Theming
phases.goal: Establish shared UI shell, design tokens, and the Prisma client singleton.

steps.description: Configure Tailwind CSS v4 theme colors, fonts, and premium-card utilities in src/app/globals.css.
Create root layout with sticky Navbar and Footer using the max-w-7xl container rule.
Create a Prisma client singleton at src/lib/prisma.ts.
Replace the starter landing page with a basic HealthCapsule hero and CTA.

phases.summary: Phase 1 complete: Tailwind v4 theme configured with brand colors/fonts/utilities; sticky Navbar and Footer created with max-w-7xl containers; Prisma client singleton and Prisma 7 config added; landing page replaced with HealthCapsule hero and CTAs. All builds and type checks pass.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

phases.name: Auth & Roles
phases.goal: Implement phone + password authentication and role-based route protection.

steps.description: Configure NextAuth v4 Credentials provider with phone/password lookup and bcryptjs verification.
Enrich session/JWT with user id and role (DOCTOR, ADMIN, etc.).
Create /login page and a reusable sign-out button in the Navbar.
Add middleware protecting /portal/* routes by role.

phases.summary: Phase 2 complete: NextAuth v4 configured with phone/password credentials and bcryptjs; JWT/session enriched with id and role; server/client session helpers added; /login page and /portal role redirect created; Navbar shows dynamic AuthStatus; SessionProvider wraps the app; middleware protects /portal/* routes by role. All builds pass.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

phases.name: Schema Extension & Seed Data
phases.goal: Add the Schedule model and populate the database with geography, specialties, and sample doctors.

steps.description: Add a Schedule model linked to Chamber with dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, slotDurationMinutes, and maxPatients.
Create prisma/seed.ts that loads /mnt/d/Work/location/*.json, inserts specialties, and creates sample doctors/chambers/schedules.
Generate and apply the Prisma migration for the schema extension.

phases.name: Doctor Directory API & Public Pages
phases.goal: Build the public search API, listing page, and SEO-friendly doctor profile pages.

steps.description: Implement GET /api/doctors with filters (specialty, area, name) and featured-first / new-doctor ranking.
Implement GET /api/doctors/[slug] returning full profile or 404.
Build /doctors server page with filter UI and skeleton loaders.
Build /doctors/[slug] server page with BMDC badge, degrees, fee, chambers, and schedule; use notFound() for unknown slugs.

phases.name: Doctor Portal
phases.goal: Allow authenticated doctors to edit their own profile and chambers.

steps.description: Build /portal/doctor page with forms for bio, photo, fee, degrees, languages, and chamber list.
Implement PATCH /api/doctor/profile enforcing ownership via session user id.
Implement chamber + schedule management endpoints under /api/doctor/chambers.
Verify a doctor edit updates the public profile immediately.

phases.name: Admin Portal
phases.goal: Allow admin users to verify/reject doctors and toggle listing tiers.

steps.description: Build /portal/admin page listing pending/verified doctors with verification and tier controls.
Implement PATCH /api/admin/doctors/[id]/verify to update verificationStatus and verifiedById.
Implement PATCH /api/admin/doctors/[id]/tier to update listingTier and featuredUntil.
Verify only VERIFIED doctors appear on public pages and featured doctors rank first.
